rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for a person or organization consulted for advice or expertise.

example.english: Our company hired a marketing consultant to help us.
example.traditional: 我哋公司請咗個市場顧問幫手。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 gung1 si1 cing2 zo2 go3 si5 coeng4 gu3 man6 bong1 sau2

rows.note: Use this specifically for a senior hospital specialist doctor in the medical hierarchy.

example.english: I have to go to the hospital tomorrow to see the consultant for a follow-up appointment.
example.traditional: 我聽日要去醫院搵顧問醫生覆診。
example.jyutping: ngo5 ting1 jat6 jiu3 heoi3 ji1 jyun2 wan2 gu3 man6 ji1 sang1 fuk1 zan2
